design_step: order of work 3.6: the contamination and independence reports, over the final corpus

tool.name: check_corpus.py (authoring-stage independence tool, blueprint §4)
tool.note: the stage-4 forked module g_route4_independence does not exist yet (implementation is order-of-work step 4); N9, its byte-identity test, is verified at IR

scope.pool: one pool per class: all 584 G-ROUTE4 fixtures (A′ and B′, main and reserve) with the 20 fixes overlaid (N7: a fixed text replaces its old text; boilerplate recomputed over the whole pool), plus G-ROUTE3's A and B fixtures of the class; G-ROUTE3 pairs among themselves are not compared
scope.o3: all authored G-ROUTE4 fixtures of every class, main and reserve, pairwise and against all G-ROUTE3 A and B fixtures; lowercase vocabulary per class pool only
scope.o4_conversation: no signature (conversation relies on the family rules, the answer-position balance, the no-identical-gold rule and the corpus review)
scope.fine_signature: research and extraction, A′ against B′ within a cell; planning and synthesis exempt (declared loosening); conversation no signature
scope.o6: all classes pooled; G-ROUTE4 main and reserve plus all G-ROUTE3 A and B fixtures

o6_fields.ordinary_conversation: every input field except the message
o6_fields.structured_extraction: gold values of free-text (non-enum) string fields
o6_fields.reflective_planning: allowed action names and the objective

scope.o6_normalization: canonical_value, casefold, strip; closed-vocabulary sets and structural-id fields excluded

conversation.fine_signature: none (declared in the design; conversation relies on reasoning-pattern review)
conversation.ledger: message = request unit + one unit per option; every unit carries recomputed facts

planning.fine_signature: exempt (declared in the design; planning and synthesis)

o3_entities.scope: all authored G-ROUTE4 fixtures of every class, main and reserve, pairwise and against all G-ROUTE3 A and B fixtures

o3_identifier_gate.status: binding prospective O3 identifier gate for G-ROUTE4; the frozen G-ROUTE3 detector is unchanged and G-ROUTE3 is not rescored

names.english_screen: committed name stream (screened at build against the recorded dictionary digests); replayed here with no dictionary

o6.pool: all classes pooled; G-ROUTE4 main and reserve plus all G-ROUTE3 A and B fixtures

sealed_baseline.note: the sealed corpus alone (no fixes), same tool and pool: the pre-existing structure
